title_zh: 免費網上講座：關係場域死去之後，點樣搵返自己（Sarah Peyton）
title_en: Free Webinar: Killing the Field — and What to Do When It Has Died (Sarah Peyton)
summary_zh: Sarah Peyton 免費年度網上講座。2026 年 12 月 8 日美西時間 18:00–20:00 以 Zoom 舉行（港澳 12 月 9 日 10:00–12:00），探討治療中共同創造的共享空間（場域）、場域死去時嘅震驚與信任斷裂，以及點樣透過共鳴修復。包括一對一共鳴示範及線上系統排列示範，登記後可收錄影。
summary_en: A free annual process work webinar from Sarah Peyton on 8 December 2026, 6:00-8:00pm Pacific (10:00-12:00 Macau time on 9 December), held via Zoom. It explores the shared relational field co-created in sessions, what happens when that field dies, and how resonance work can help practitioners and clients recover aliveness. Two live demonstrations: a one-to-one resonance session and an online constellation. Recordings are available to registrants.
